recipes.title: Classic Cast-Iron Butter-Basted Ribeye
ingredients: 3 tbsp butter, 4 cloves garlic, thyme, rosemary
Coarse sea salt and cracked pepper
instructions: Bring the ribeye / NY strip / filet mignon to room temperature 30 mins before cooking; pat completely dry.
Season generously on all sides with coarse kosher salt and cracked black pepper.
Cook using pan-searing & butter basting over high heat to build a deep caramelized crust.
Baste with foaming butter, aromatics, or glazes during the final minutes of cooking.
Rest meat on cutting board 5-10 minutes before slicing across the grain.
